capacity:limiter.message: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 20/s and handles 10/s (200%): 10/s may be rejected.
capacity:limiter.rationale: Demand above what a service can handle never drains: latency and backlog grow until something times out. Live view's Show capacity has the same numbers.
